REVERSIBILITY IS NOT DERIVED: the manuscript's own status remark calls the bijective substratum a representation choice recovered by a two-pronged argument one prong of which is empirical, so phi is a hypothesis (Equiv.Perm S) everywhere and no theorem concludes that the substratum is bijective; what IS proved from finiteness is the structural prong, injective_imp_bijective. And the selection principle is not silently upgraded to uniqueness: invariance_does_not_select is a THEOREM -- two disjoint nonempty invariant sets carry two distinct invariant probability laws -- with two_cycle_witness supplying the double transposition so it is not vacuous. Orbit uniqueness, invariance of the counting measure, and its entropy maximality are the other three clauses. The continuum analogue about Liouville measure was moved out of the lemma statement into its own following remark, so the lemma's formal obligation is now entirely finite and this entry's coverage is exact. The non-selection clause is discharged by invariance_does_not_select, which the probe checks exhaustively over all 873 permutations of up to six states (invariant-subspace dimension = cycle count) -- stronger for the framework than the continuum analogy, since it proves the phenomenon in the setting actually consumed downstream.

entries.label: (stochastic inverse)
entries.assumptions: a finite square stochastic matrix with a one-sided stochastic inverse
entries.note: Closed in b448, rank 1 of the backlog, from P. The proof is the manuscript's own, step for step: vanishing off-diagonal entries of A*B force every row of B indexed by the support of a row of A to be a basis vector; two such rows would coincide, which a nonzero determinant forbids; so each row of A carries a single unit entry and the occupied columns are distinct. Both sides of "left or right" are covered without separate proofs, because a one-sided inverse of a square matrix over a commutative ring is two-sided. The countercontrol in the companion probe shows the hypothesis is load-bearing: [[1/2,1/2],[0,1]] is stochastic and invertible and is NOT a permutation, its inverse simply failing to be stochastic.

entries.label: 1 (boundary bound)
entries.assumptions: the block decomposition of the update on a region R
entries.note: AUDITED BEFORE FORMALIZING, and the lemma survived intact. Exhaustive check over all 316 proper nonempty regions of four paths, four cycles, a 2x3 grid and a star: no violation of either bound, and both bounds attained. TWO LAYERS, DELIBERATELY SEPARATED, because the mathematics is a support statement and the rank bound is its reading over a ring where rank means the usual thing. rank_le_card_of_rowSupport is proved for an ARBITRARY commutative ring with the strong rank condition, with no lattice, no adjacency and no ZMod anywhere in its section -- the probe's lint enforces that: a matrix whose rows vanish off a finite B equals extend B times its own B-rows (eq_extend_mul_restrict, the ring-independent content), hence has rank at most |B|. The OI consumer then instantiates it twice. THE FACTOR OF TWO IS THE THING TO GET WRONG. Each site carries two components, so the visible sector has dimension 2|R|, and yet the bounds count SITES. The reason is that exactly one output row per site participates: v'_x = u_x reads a single input from its own sector, so its row in the cross-block is identically zero. rowsHV and rowsVH therefore carry .val.2 = false as half of their defining condition, and rowsHV_card / rowsVH_card are where |boundary| rather than 2|boundary| is earned. The probe guards this twice: B4 checks all 1714 v'-rows vanish, and B3 checks the bound is ATTAINED, so a spurious factor of two would be provably not tight. B7 is the other miscount: a star with four leaves visible has four edges crossing the cut and one boundary site, and the rank is one -- the bound is by boundary sites. MANUSCRIPT SHARPENING, applied. The prose after the proof said the rank argument 'uses no property of the coefficient ring' and 'holds verbatim over Z_q'. For composite q ordinary vector-space rank is not the same object, so what is ring-independent is the FACTORIZATION; the rank inequality is its reading over a field. Both the proof remark and the scope remark now say that, in all three parallel sources. ONE OBSERVATION NOT PRINTED AND NOT RELIED ON: the columns of each cross-block are supported on the other boundary, so both ranks are in fact bounded by min(|inner|, |outer|), verified on every region and with the two boundaries differing in size in 168 of them. That would strengthen Corollary 2; it is recorded in the probe as B8 and left as a manuscript decision. The Lean file proves the printed row-side bound only. SHARPENED, WITH THE SCOPE GUARD EXPLICIT. The columns of each cross-block are supported on the OTHER boundary, so both ranks are bounded by min(|dR-|, |dR+|) -- kernel-proved as lemma_1_sharpened. That needs adjacency SYMMETRY, which the row-side lemma does not: innerB and outerB orient their edges into the named site while a column entry records an edge out of its input site, and only symmetry identifies the two. The hypothesis is therefore explicit (hsym : forall x y, adj x y -> adj y x) rather than ambient, the probe's lint fails if it leaks into lemma_1_boundary_bound's signature, and B10 exhibits a one-edge digraph where the min bound fails outright in both orientations while both printed row-side bounds hold. The sharpening is what the strengthened Corollary 2 consumes; the row-side lemma keeps the arbitrary relation and with it the manuscript's 'weakened form for arbitrary nearest-neighbour bijections'.

entries.label: (separability threshold)
entries.assumptions: G an abelian subgroup of the Weyl group on s qubits of order 2^t modulo phases
entries.note: BOTH DIRECTIONS KERNEL-PROVED. WeylLift.entanglementBreaking_iff is the printed statement: for an isotropic G, the twirl Phi_G is entanglement breaking exactly when |G| = 2^s. Its hypotheses name only G -- no tuple, no basis, no Clifford reduction -- and the probe's lint reads the signature and fails if a tuple, a lift or a projector leaks into it. entanglementBreaking_iff_dim is the same statement in the manuscript's parameterization, EB(Phi_G) iff t = s where |G| = 2^t. THE ROUTE, LAYER BY LAYER. (1) OIBridge/WeylTwirl.lean: the phase space, the Weyl operators, the product rule, the conjugation character W u W v W u* = (-1)^omega(u,v) W v, commutation as vanishing of the symplectic form, and the exact twirl identity twirl_W. Plus the symplectic count -- nondegeneracy, the character sum over the whole phase space, and from them |G| . |G-perp| = 2^s . 2^s, the manuscript's dim G + dim G-perp = 2s in the multiplicative form the twirl's normalization uses -- giving (G-perp)-perp = G, |G| <= 2^s for isotropic G, and |G| = 2^s iff G-perp = G. The last of these is what the iff's contrapositive turns on. No Mathlib dimension theory is invoked: the count comes off the same character sum as the twirl identity, which also sidesteps an instance mismatch between the Submodule built over ZMod 2's CommRing and the Field structure BilinForm.finrank_orthogonal wants. (2) OIBridge/Separability.lean: the Choi matrix, partial transpose on the second factor, separability as finite sums of pure product projectors, separable_imp_ppt, the rank-one Choi bridge choi_conj_of_factor, and the fixed-plane refutation not_eb_of_fixed_plane. Positivity is DEFINED there rather than imported -- Mathlib's PosSemidef needs the order on C, which lives only in the ComplexOrder scope -- as PosSemidefOn, which is the form both directions want. (3) OIBridge/WeylLift.lean, WHICH EXISTS BECAUSE THE OBVIOUS ROUTE IS FALSE. The self-adjoint normalization H(u) = i^{b.a} W(u) is Hermitian, squares to 1 and commutes on omega = 0, but it is a PROJECTIVE representation of an isotropic subspace: H_mul gives H u H v = beta(u,v) H(u+v) with an explicit scalar, and H_not_multiplicative exhibits a commuting pair at s = 2 with beta = -1, because d(u+v) = d(u) + d(v) + omega(u,v) holds in ZMod 2 while the exponents of i add in Z. So P_chi = |G|^{-1} sum_g chi(g) H(g) is not idempotent; its trace is still 1, which is what makes the error easy to miss, and its rank is 2^s. The cocycle is a coboundary, but not merely because each H(u) is an involution: what trivializes it is that on an ISOTROPIC subspace a chosen F_2-basis gives COMMUTING involutions, whose ordered products are an honest representation. WeylLift makes that choice explicit and proves lift_mul. THE TWO DIRECTIONS, both consuming the same projectors. Maximal: exists_lagrangian_tuple extracts an independent spanning tuple of length exactly s from an arbitrary Lagrangian, greedily and with no basis theory; lift_conj says conjugation by a lift is conjugation by its Weyl operator, the unit scalar cancelling against its own conjugate, so the tuple-dependent construction reproduces the tuple-independent twirl; sum_P_conj_eq_twirl is the dephasing identity sum_chi P_chi rho P_chi = Phi_G(rho); and rank one is consumed ALGEBRAICALLY -- exists_factor_of_finrank_range_eq_one turns finrank of range equal to 1 into an entrywise factorization P a i = x a . y i, and choi_conj_of_factor turns that into a pure product projector. Non-maximal: trace_P_nonmaximal gives trace 2^(s-t) >= 2; exists_minor_ne_of_idem_trace converts that into a non-vanishing 2x2 minor, since an idempotent all of whose minors vanish factors and has trace 0 or 1; the two columns the minor names span a plane twirl_fixes_plane fixes pointwise; and not_eb_of_fixed_plane refutes entanglement breaking with the single antisymmetric witness w(i,a) = conj(x_i) conj(y_a) - conj(y_i) conj(x_a), on which the partially transposed Choi form is -sum |y_a x_b - x_a y_b|^2. WHAT IS NOT USED ANYWHERE: no eigenvector, no orthonormal basis, no square root, no spectral theorem, no Schmidt decomposition, no PPT characterization, no Witt extension, no Clifford group, and -- in the non-maximal direction -- no anticommuting pair. perp_perp remains proved and remains the explanation of what survives below maximality, but the block-rank route is shorter and is almost entirely a consumer of machinery the maximal direction already needed. THREE CONVENTION GATES, each guarded by a numerical countercontrol on genuinely complex data because the wrong variants coincide with the right one on real vectors: the Choi ancilla-first index order, the ancilla-takes-y order in choi_conj_of_factor, and the double conjugation in the antisymmetric witness -- for which all four obvious variants get the value wrong and all four come out non-negative, so each would refute nothing. SCOPE AUDITED BEFORE FORMALIZING, and the statement survived intact -- unlike [Structure] 9.7, which the same pass found false. Every step checks out: abelian is isotropic, isotropy bounds t <= s, Witt plus Clifford give D_t (x) id, complete dephasing is measure-and-prepare, and the tensor-factor step is correct with the justification given (separability survives the partial trace). Endpoints behave: t = 0 gives the identity channel, non-EB for s >= 1; s = 0 is degenerate and consistent; a G containing -I is handled by 'modulo phases'. Verified independently by exhaustive enumeration over all abelian Weyl subgroups at s = 1 and s = 2 -- NPT for every t < s, PPT with an explicit measure-and-prepare form at t = s, and isotropic-subspace counts 1/3 and 1/15/15 matching the 15 Lagrangians of Sp(4,2). TWO MODELLING DECISIONS, both recorded in Lean rather than asserted. G is an ISOTROPIC SUBSPACE of F_2^{2s}, not a Pauli subgroup: the set {X^a Z^b} is not closed under multiplication, since (XZ)^2 = -1, so 'a subgroup of order 2^t' is not a statement about it and the manuscript's 'modulo phases' is load-bearing; the probe's W6 is the countercontrol. And the route needs NO WITT EXTENSION AND NO CLIFFORD GROUP: the twirl identity lets both directions be read off G and G-perp directly, for every isotropic subspace, without building the finite Clifford representation -- a simplification of the route, not of the result, and the probe's lint enforces that neither appears.

entries.note: SCOPE REPAIR FOUND BY FORMALIZING, then closed. The corollary assumed only a finite second moment and concluded an O(|k|^4) remainder; finite second moment gives o(|k|^2) and nothing sharper, since a symmetric kernel can have finite second moment and infinite fourth moment. The statement is now split into clause (i) at o(|k|^2) under a second moment -- which carries the whole negative content -- and clause (ii) at O(|k|^4) under a fourth moment. KERNEL-PROVED, the whole chain from the manuscript's own hypothesis: KernelOh (kernel O_h-equivariance) gives ohInvariant_mom2 (the SECOND MOMENT TENSOR is O_h-invariant) -- the step that was implicit and is now derived -- which with the algebraic core ohInvariant_iff gives dim Sym^2(R^3)^{O_h} = 1 and hence mom2_quadratic_isotropic. Inversion evenness (kernelOh_neg) is derived from the group and reduces the exponential symbol to a cosine series (symbolC_eq_symbol) rather than that form being assumed. On a lattice the second moment gives absolute summability for free (summable_abs_of_mom2, since |v|^2 >= 1 off the origin). symbol_expansion, then rem_littleO by dominated convergence for series -- the uniform bound |cos t - 1 + t^2/2| <= t^2/2 dominates, the global quartic bound t^4/2 gives the pointwise limit -- and rem_bigO for clause (ii) with an explicit constant. corollary_1a is the wrapper. quartic_not_isotropic supplies the 'need not be rotationally invariant' clause. The probe keeps the boundary witness that motivated the repair (axis weights r^-4) as a regression guard on the split.

OIBridge/QuarterTurn.lean builds the cubic rotation group as S4 acting by CONJUGATION on its six four-cycles -- the six quarter turns, hence the six oriented axes -- so the orbit is S4/C4 with no quotient formalized (each stabilizer is the centralizer C4) and antipodality is canonical, q -> q^-1. THE NAME IS A THEOREM: isRot_iff proves the image of the action is EXACTLY the antipode-preserving permutations of the six signed links whose 3x3 signed-permutation matrix has determinant +1, detLink_eq_det ties that hand-written determinant to Mathlib's, card_sym counts the antipode-preserving group at 48 (O_h) and card_rot the rotations at 24 (O), and antiPerm_not_isRot certifies that the inversion -I -- the element separating them -- is absent. THE ACCEPTANCE GATE, character_gate, then proves pointwise that the fixed-link character is the manuscript's own (6, 0, 2, 0, 2); it fires before any representation theory is attached, its absence being what admitted a wrong S4-set once. THE REPRESENTATION rhoLinkQT g = permOp (linkAct g^-1) carries the inverse because permOp is an anti-homomorphism (permOp_mul). The three summands are bundled as Mathlib Subrepresentations TsubQT/EsubQT/AsubQT, so the conclusions are about Representation.character and not about restricted traces that resemble one. The five S4 characters -- A1 = 1, A2 = sign, E = fix3 - 1, T1 = sign * (fix4 - 1), T2 = fix4 - 1, T1 being standard-TENSOR-sign because a four-fold rotation is an ODD permutation -- are proved orthonormal (irr_orthonormal, 5x5 = 24 delta), and mult_link gives 24*(1,0,1,1,0) against the DERIVED chiLink rather than a transcribed table: no A2, no T2. character_rhoT_eq / character_rhoE_eq / character_rhoA_eq identify the three summands' characters through IdempotentTrace.trace_restrict_range, dimensions 3, 2, 1 come from trace_eq_finrank_range, and chiT_c4 pins the three-dimensional summand as T1 rather than T2 -- the two differ exactly at the four-fold class. Irreducibility over Q, not over an algebraically closed field, and in the strict sense: irreducible_rhoT / irreducible_rhoE / irreducible_rhoA assert Representation.IsIrreducible -- no proper nonzero subrepresentation -- not merely dim End = 1. Each self-inner-product is 24, so finrank_intertwiners gives an endomorphism algebra of dimension one over Q with no complexification; the step from there to irreducibility is Maschke, and Mathlib carries that implication only in the converse direction and only under [IsAlgClosed k]. OIBridge/Irreducibility.lean supplies the direction needed here without that hypothesis: Maschke gives every subrepresentation an invariant complement, the projection onto it along that complement is equivariant, and a one-dimensional endomorphism algebra forces that projection to be a single scalar, which a nonzero vector in each summand pins to 1 and to 0 at once unless one summand is zero. The probe's L6g is the countercontrol: the upper-triangular 2x2 algebra has a one-dimensional endomorphism algebra and a reducible module, so semisimplicity is load-bearing rather than decorative. The wrapper theorem_7_link bundles the rotation-group certificate, the gate, the three characters, the dimensions, the three irreducibility statements, and the TERMINAL EQUIVARIANT EQUIVALENCE decompEquiv : V6 = T1 + E + A1 given by v -> (P_T v, P_E v, P_A v). SCOPE: the file proves GEOMETRY. H-link appears only as the hypothesis of the separate, equivariant hlink_transport, and H-cust appears nowhere -- the probe's lint enforces both. CubicIsotropy's 48-element O_h is neither imported nor mentioned. SEPARATELY OPEN, as the A10 gap: the six-face/six-link equivariant identification, and OIBridge.lean's Cubic section, whose 72, 288 and 144 are statements about the two-subset action and carry no link-physics reading until re-established against linkAct.

entries.label: 9.7a (Minimal Kraus uniqueness)
entries.assumptions: finite-dimensional visible sector; each Kraus family LINEARLY INDEPENDENT, which is minimality

checks.evidence: THE THEOREM, as a round trip

entries.note: KERNEL-PROVED, with the scope repair that preceded it. The former Proposition 9.7 was FALSE as an identity of operators; it was split, and 9.7a is the algebraic core. OIBridge/KrausUniqueness.lean proves it: proposition_9_7a gives equal cardinality (Fintype.card J = Fintype.card I), a UNIQUE unitary on the coefficient space, the Kraus relation B_j = sum_i U_ji A_i in the manuscript's index order, U U^H = 1, and the transpose relating that order to the factor's column matrix. THE UNIQUENESS IS NOT REPROVED HERE: it is OIBridge/FactorUniqueness.lean's existsUnique_unitary_factor, stated with no channel, no Kraus family and no dilation, over an arbitrary RCLike field and with the two index types independent so that equal cardinality is a conclusion. THE FOUR JOINS this file adds: (1) the synthesis map e_i -> vec(A_i) with its analysis map proved to be the adjoint through eq_adjoint_iff; (2) gram_entry, the synthesis Gram operator with all four indices explicit; (3) krausMap_single plus synth_gram_eq_of_krausMap_eq -- evaluating the channel at the matrix unit E_bd and reading entry (a,c) gives exactly the ((a,b),(c,d)) Gram entry, so channel equality IS Gram equality with NOTHING in between; (4) synth_injective_of_linearIndependent, linear independence being injectivity, which is why the hypothesis is independence rather than 'minimal hidden-sector dimension'. NO CHOI LAYER AND NO POSITIVITY: X X* is called the synthesis GRAM operator because positivity is never used -- no Choi theorem, no complete positivity, no spectral theorem, no Cholesky factorization, no pseudoinverse, and no trace, so trace preservation is not assumed either. The probe's lint enforces each absence. THE ORIENTATION IS A THEOREM: Y = X W in the column convention reads B_j = sum_i W_ij A_i while the manuscript writes B_j = sum_i U_ji A_i, so U is the TRANSPOSE, recorded as krausMatrix_eq_transpose; the probe's K4 builds a complex non-symmetric U, discards it, recovers the column factor, certifies W^T = U with W != U, and checks that the SWAPPED index order fails -- so a transposition would be a numerical failure rather than a silent one.

entries.label: 9.7b (Minimal pure-reference dilation uniqueness)
entries.assumptions: PURE reference states; both realizations minimal; conclusion is about the isometry, not the full unitary

checks.evidence: PROPOSITION 9.7b, and exactly where it stops

entries.note: KERNEL-PROVED, and it stops where the repair says it must. OIBridge/StinespringUniqueness.lean's proposition_9_7b gives equal environment dimension and a UNIQUE isometric T with V2 = (1 (x) T) V1 -- and nothing about the full dilating unitaries, which the CNOT pair in stinespring_scope_probe.py certifies are not determined off the prepared reference subspace. THREE GATES, not one reassembly. (1) minimal_iff_linearIndependent proves that MINIMALITY IS KRAUS INDEPENDENCE in the manuscript's own cyclicity form -- Minimal is span {(M (x) 1) V psi} = top with M ranging over ALL of B(H_V), containing no finrank and no cardinality, so it is not the independence it is proved equivalent to. The proof goes through the orthogonal complement: inner_ampl_eq puts the inner product against the cyclic set in closed form, orthogonal_iff turns orthogonality into the annihilation of the Kraus family by the coefficients conj(u(a,i)), and independence closes both directions. It carries [Nonempty n], which is load-bearing rather than decorative: with a zero visible space every dilation is vacuously cyclic while its Kraus family need not be independent, and a zero visible space is not an embedded observer. (2) channel_eq_krausMap proves the Stinespring channel -- defined as what it is, conjugation by V summed over the environment index -- is the Kraus map of A_i = (1 (x) <i|) V, so KrausUniqueness can consume it. (3) THE ORIENTATION, and it is the TRANSPOSE, not the adjoint: FactorUniqueness produces the column factor W : H_H^(2) -> H_H^(1) and the environment unitary runs the other way with T_ji = W(e_j)_i, so the adjoint -- which conjugates the entries -- is a different operator whenever they are not real. hiddenUnitary is built with the transpose orientation, hiddenUnitary_matrix identifies its matrix with KrausUniqueness.krausMatrix (the manuscript's U, in the manuscript's index order), and the probe's G3 uses a complex non-symmetric witness for which the transpose reassembles V2 exactly and the adjoint does not. UNIQUENESS IS PROVED, not inherited: amplR_ext shows the environment operator is determined, again from independence of the Kraus family, so the wrapper is an existential-unique as the manuscript states. The uniqueness of the coefficient factor is KrausUniqueness/FactorUniqueness and is not reproved.

entries.delta: THE TWO NEGATIVE CLAUSES. Kernel-proved: the first positive half -- for a minimal pure-reference representative the embedded observer determines the Stinespring isometry up to a unique hidden-sector unitary, which is StinespringUniqueness.proposition_9_7b. NOT kernel-proved, and recorded as this entry's delta: (a) that the extension of that isometry to a FULL tensor-product unitary is unconstrained off the prepared reference subspace, and (b) that non-minimal realizations introduce further enlargement freedom. Both are negative existence statements about the dilating unitary, and the Lean layer deliberately carries no unitary-realization formalism -- 9.7b is stated for the isometry alone. (a) is witnessed by the CNOT pair in stinespring_scope_probe.py (same channel, same environment, both minimal, minimality forcing W = 1, and the two unitaries differing), which is evidence and not a kernel proof. Formalizing (a) would need the unitary layer built on top of the present isometry layer; (b) would need the non-minimal case.
entries.note: STRENGTHENED AND SCOPED. The earlier form named two freedoms in the substratum description, hidden-sector unitary and deep-sector enlargement. There are three: the extension of the Stinespring isometry to a full tensor-product unitary is additionally unconstrained off the prepared reference subspace. The correction WIDENS the gauge freedom, so the substratum-is-gauge reading survives and is reinforced; only 9.7's precise form changed. The corollary now carries the qualification that the second freedom is gauge relative to the fixed-reference observational interface: the off-reference action of U is invisible to the channel only because Definition 9.2 always prepares the same rho_H, and would become observable if the hidden sector were independently preparable.

unattached.certifies: NOTHING -- a recorded DEFECT, found by formalizing SM:T-7 and stated in Lean as char_two_subset_ne_link. Cubic.rho is the permutation representation of S4 on the six TWO-ELEMENT SUBSETS of the four body diagonals, which its header calls 'the six faces of the cube'. They are not: a face meets every body diagonal and so determines no pair of them; the six two-element subsets are the six pairs of opposite edges.
unattached.note: The two representations have the SAME character multiset {6, 2x9, 0x14} -- which is all representation_bridge_probe's multiset comparison ever checked -- and differ as class functions: two-subsets gives (6,0,2,2,0) on (E,8C3,3C2,6C2',6C4) while the six links give (6,0,2,0,2), the manuscript's own proof line. So Cubic.rho carries T2 where the links carry T1: the two three-dimensional irreducibles, swapped. The six links are the coset space S4/C4, which this section had recorded as a control 'rejected because it has the same character' -- the same multiset collision read the wrong way round. Consequences: the A10 face/link identification is NOT closed; LinkJoin's faceEquivLink and linkHom are true as stated but transport the two-subset action, so they are not the rotation action on the coordinate links; and the character sums 72/288/144 in this section are sums for the two-subset representation, which any downstream physical reading of them has to take account of. Three permanent regression controls now record WHY the previous evidence was insufficient: the two characters agree as multisets (char_multiset_collision, which is exactly what the old probe compared) and on the aggregate power sums this bridge reports, sum chi^2 = 72 and sum chi^3 = 288 for both (sum_sq_collision, sum_cube_collision). The two differing classes, 6C2' and 6C4, both have six elements, so the contributions trade places. Those numbers being right is therefore not evidence that the physical representation was right. PARTIALLY ADDRESSED: OIBridge/QuarterTurn.lean now builds the CORRECT six-link action -- S4 by conjugation on its six four-cycles -- and character_gate confirms its character is (6,0,2,0,2), so SM:T-7 no longer needs the face model at all. What is still open is this section's own reading: Cubic.rho and its 72/288/144 sums remain statements about the two-subset representation, and any downstream physical use of finrank_commutant = 3 or finrank_hom_end = 12 as LINK-representation facts must be re-established against QuarterTurn.linkAct. The 144 broken-sector contraction in particular has NOT been checked for invariance under the T1/T2 swap.

backlog_policy: LEAN-FIRST. Every established canonical mathematical result is a kernel-formalization target by default. GAP IS A BACKLOG STATE AND NOT AN ACCEPTABLE TERMINAL VERIFICATION STATE. An exception requires a RECORDED REASON -- empirical input, an external literature premise, a physical assumption, or a formal library result that does not yet exist -- and even then Lean should prove the implication FROM that premise wherever possible: A_1 and ... and A_n implies the framework conclusion, which is exactly where the framework's own deduction ends and an external assumption begins. Formalization order: central OI/equivalence chain, foundational OI lemmas, existing ROADMAP gaps, reconstruction/representation, comb/locality, GR/SM deductions, then secondary corollaries and controls. WITHIN each tier take the easy K3 conversions first so coverage rises quickly, but NEVER let that displace a central theorem merely because it is harder. And the probes are preserved after Lean catches up: the standard is Lean theorem PLUS independent executable probe PLUS countercontrols, never Lean instead of probes.
